description: Figure tracks for NM26 g4 (scripts/synth/track-figures.py): every 6 frames, and every frame around each goal (dense = 1). Skaters: model v2b on kit-colour-localised crops; goalies: model C. u = slot position 0-1 along the slot centreline (data/geometry.json); theta_deg = rotation relative to the team's home heading (W 0, E 180); slot_dist_mm = how far the predicted pivot lies from the slot (large = doubtful). PROPOSED, unsmoothed.
